newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice closes lower on commercial selling.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice closes lower on commercial selling.

text.p: Small-lot and scattered commercial selling pressed CBOT rice futures to a lower close with the activity tied to a slight hike in producer and reseller movement, traders said.
"There was commercial and small spec (speculative) selling," a trader said.
Traders said good demand was evident at roughly the $11.45 per cwt level in the March contract.
Rice futures volume was estimated by the CBOT at 400 contracts, below the 533 traded Thursday.
Rice futures closed seven to 10 cents per cwt lower, with January down seven at $11.32.
